Maybe I should have bought a bowl, but I wasn't really hungry.

Summary:
Yeah, disappointed with my rolls.
Gyoza was good thought

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo_Master_Consolidation.xlsx — Weekly Summary. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers were 1,150, up 21 (1.86%) year on year.
Spend per head was reported at £24.32, up £1.82 (8.08%) year on year.
Sales were £28,235.49, beating the £24,900 target by £3,335.49 (13.39%); the BOH meeting sheet shows £28,449.01 (+14.25%).
Operational labour was £5,360.06 with minimal hours in play, total labour all in was £6,290.22 and 361.92 hours were used, with labour at 18.89% on the BOH meeting sheet.
It was a smooth week, with Penny covering the site on the BOH call as the manager was not available.
BOH and FOH staffing were reported as stable.

The sushi chef has handed in notice and leaves this coming Sunday; this is fine short term, but a long term sushi hire is needed in Glasgow, with a final decision awaited when Justyna is back from holiday.
With a Maki 8 team member away for three months, the plan is to share labour between Maki 6 and Maki 8.

The site received five Google reviews (4.60 average), including a 3 star review on 02/10 saying the rainbow roll was disappointing, the rice too sticky and it was overpriced, tagged hygiene of premises; the sushi chef was checked and had followed the recipe.
Site compliance is all up to date and there is no maintenance for this week.
GM/HC notes are incorporated within the KPI Report.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): last week's chicken broth usage discrepancy was traced to a takeaway recipe still linked to the old tonkotsu broth in stock counts, which has been corrected, so usage should return to normal next week.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): Bidfood is being brought in as a new supplier, starting with Aberdeen and reaching the other sites within one to two months, and new beef samples are being trialled with a view to pre-cooked beef so sites no longer cook it themselves.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): frozen ramen promotion stock is delivered from the factory on 07/10, but storage space at the smaller sites is unconfirmed and the memo does not specify quantities per flavour.
actions: Decide on the long term sushi chef hire for Glasgow - Owner: Justyna Polak (13/10/2026)
